title: Drive around with me from Harker Heights To Killeen Texas
description:
Enjoy this video of #Harkerheights Texas as I drive you around the business area to its residential area. The city might be small but it's in the middle of the metropolitan Killeen Temple Fort Hood area. Close to a hospital, mall in killeen and there's a bunch of little cafes and restaurants.
